Track.name: createTrackBank
Track.signature: TrackBank createTrackBank ( final int numTracks , final int numSends , final int numScenes , final boolean hasFlatTrackList )
Track.documentation: Returns a track bank with the given number of child tracks, sends and scenes. The track bank will only have content if the connected track is a group track. A track bank can be seen as a fixed-size window onto the list of tracks in the connected track group including their sends and scenes, that can be scrolled in order to access different parts of the track list. For example a track bank configured for 8 tracks can show track 1-8, 2-9, 3-10 and so on. The idea behind the bank pattern is that hardware typically is equipped with a fixed amount of channel strips or controls, for example consider a mixing console with 8 channels, but Bitwig Studio documents contain a dynamic list of tracks, most likely more tracks than the hardware can control simultaneously. The track bank returned by this function provides a convenient interface for controlling which tracks are currently shown on the hardware. Creating a track bank using this method will consider all tracks in the document, including effect tracks and the master track. Use createMainTrackBank or createEffectTrackBank in case you are only interested in tracks of a certain kind. Parameters numTracks the number of child tracks spanned by the track bank numSends the number of sends spanned by the track bank numScenes the number of scenes spanned by the track bank hasFlatTrackList specifies whether the track bank should operate on a flat list of all nested child tracks or only on the direct child tracks of the connected group track. Returns an object for bank-wise navigation of tracks, sends and scenes See also createMainTrackBank createEffectTrackBank Since API version 1

SettableRangedValue.documentation: Increments or decrements the value according to the given increment and resolution parameters. Typically the resolution would be specified as the amount of steps the hardware control provides (for example 128) and just pass the integer value as it comes from the MIDI device. The host application will take care of scaling it. Parameters increment the amount that the current value is increased by resolution the resolution used for scaling Since API version 1

SettableRangedValue.name: set

SettableRangedValue.name: set
SettableRangedValue.signature: void set ( Number value , Number resolution )

SettableRangedValue.name: setImmediately

Parameters value absolute value [0 .. 1] Since API version 4

SettableRangedValue.name: setRaw

UsbDeviceMatcher.name: UsbDeviceMatcher
UsbDeviceMatcher.signature: UsbDeviceMatcher ( final String name , final String expression , final UsbConfigurationMatcher configurationMatcher )
UsbDeviceMatcher.documentation: Creates a UsbDeviceMatcher that matches a USB device that matches the supplied expression and has a configuration matching the supplied UsbConfigurationMatcher . Parameters name A human friendly name that describes the kind of devices this matcher tries to match. expression An expression that can be used on the USB device descriptor to decide if the device matches. Variables in the expression can refer to the following fields of the device descriptor: bDeviceClass - bDeviceSubClass - bDeviceProtocol - idVendor - idProduct For example to match a device that has vendor id 0x10 product id 0x20 the expression would be: "idVendor == 0x10 && idProduct == 0x20" Parameters configurationMatcher Object that tries to match a configuration on the device that it can use. See also https://beyondlogic.org/usbnutshell/usb5.shtml for more information about USB device descriptors.

UsbDeviceMatcher.name: UsbDeviceMatcher
UsbDeviceMatcher.signature: UsbDeviceMatcher ( final String name , final String expression , final UsbInterfaceMatcher... interfaceMatchers )
UsbDeviceMatcher.documentation: Creates a UsbDeviceMatcher that matches a USB device that matches the supplied expression and has a configuration matching the supplied UsbInterfaceMatcher s. Parameters name A human friendly name that describes the kind of devices this matcher tries to match. expression An expression that can be used on the USB device descriptor to decide if the device matches. Variables in the expression can refer to the following fields of the device descriptor: bDeviceClass - bDeviceSubClass - bDeviceProtocol - idVendor - idProduct For example to match a device that has vendor id 0x10 product id 0x20 the expression would be: "idVendor == 0x10 && idProduct == 0x20" Parameters interfaceMatchers UsbInterfaceMatcher s that define the USB interface descriptors that a configuration of the device needs to have. See also https://beyondlogic.org/usbnutshell/usb5.shtml for more information about USB device descriptors.

UsbDeviceMatcher.name: getConfigurationMatcher

UsbDeviceMatcher.name: getExpression

ControllerHost.name: addDeviceNameBasedDiscoveryPair

ControllerHost.documentation: Registers patterns which are used to automatically detect hardware devices that can be used with the script. When the user clicks on the detect button in the Bitwig Studio controller preferences dialog, Bitwig Studio searches for connected controller hardware by comparing the parameters passed into this function are compared with the port names of the available MIDI drivers. Found controller scripts are automatically added with their input/output ports configured. Calling this function is optional, but can also be called multiple times in the global script scope in order to support alternative driver names. Parameters inputs the array of strings used to detect MIDI input ports, must not be null . outputs the array of strings used to detect MIDI output ports, must not be null . Since API version 1

ControllerHost.name: createSceneBank
ControllerHost.documentation: Returns a scene bank with the given number of scenes. A scene bank can be seen as a fixed-size window onto the list of scenes in the current document, that can be scrolled in order to access different parts of the scene list. For example a scene bank configured for 8 scenes can show scene 1-8, 2-9, 3-10 and so on. The idea behind the bank pattern is that hardware typically is equipped with a fixed amount of channel strips or controls, for example consider a mixing console with 8 channels, but Bitwig Studio documents contain a dynamic list of scenes, most likely more scenes than the hardware can control simultaneously. The scene bank returned by this function provides a convenient interface for controlling which scenes are currently shown on the hardware. HardwareControl.name: setName

ClipLauncherSlotOrScene.name: color
ClipLauncherSlotOrScene.documentation: Value that reports the color of this slot. Since API version 7 Implemented in ClipLauncherSlot .

ClipLauncherSlotOrScene.name: launchWithOptions

ClipLauncherSlotOrScene.name: moveTo
ClipLauncherSlotOrScene.documentation: Moves the current slot or scene into the destination slot or scene. Since API version 4 Deprecated: Use replaceInsertionPoint() instead.

DeviceChain.name: endOfDeviceChainInsertionPoint

DeviceChain.name: select
DeviceChain.documentation: Deprecated: Use selectInEditor() or Channel#selectInMixer() instead. Since API version 1

DeviceChain.name: startOfDeviceChainInsertionPoint

TrackBank.name: addCanScrollTracksDownObserver
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use canScrollChannelsDown() instead.

TrackBank.name: addCanScrollTracksUpObserver
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use canScrollChannelsUp() instead.

TrackBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the underlying total scene count (not the number of scenes available in the bank window). Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single integer parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank().itemCount().addValueObserver()

TrackBank.name: addSceneScrollPositionObserver
TrackBank.signature: void addSceneScrollPositionObserver ( IntegerValueChangedCallback callback , int valueWhenUnassigned )
TrackBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the current scene scroll position. TrackBank.name: addTrackScrollPositionObserver

TrackBank.documentation: Causes this bank to follow the supplied cursor. When the cursor moves to a new item the bank will be scrolled so that the cursor is within the bank, if possible. Parameters cursorTrack The CursorTrack that this bank should follow. Since API version 2

TrackBank.name: getClipLauncherScenes
TrackBank.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the clip launcher scenes of the track bank. Returns an object that provides access to the clip launcher scenes of the track bank. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: getTrack
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use getChannel(int) instead. Since API version 1

TrackBank.name: launchScene

TrackBank.name: sceneBank
TrackBank.documentation: SceneBank that represents a view on the scenes in this TrackBank . Since API version 2

TrackBank.name: scrollScenesDown
TrackBank.documentation: Scrolls the scenes one step down. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollScenesPageDown
TrackBank.documentation: Scrolls the scenes one page down. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollScenesPageUp
TrackBank.documentation: Scrolls the scenes one page up. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollScenesUp
TrackBank.documentation: Scrolls the scenes one step up. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollToScene
TrackBank.documentation: Makes the scene with the given position visible in the track bank. Parameters position the position of the scene within the underlying full list of scenes Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use sceneBank() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollToTrack
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use scrollToChannel(int) instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollTracksDown
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use scrollChannelsDown() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollTracksPageDown
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use scrollChannelsPageDown() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollTracksPageUp
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use scrollChannelsPageUp() instead.

TrackBank.name: scrollTracksUp
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use scrollChannelsUp() instead.

TrackBank.name: setShouldShowClipLauncherFeedback
TrackBank.documentation: Decides if Bitwig Studio's clip launcher should indicate the area being controlled by this controller or not. Since API versian 17

TrackBank.name: setTrackScrollStepSize
TrackBank.documentation: Deprecated: use setChannelScrollStepSize(int) instead.

ObjectProxy.name: createEqualsValue

ObjectProxy.name: exists
ObjectProxy.documentation: Returns a value object that indicates if the object being proxied exists, or if it has content.

PresetBrowsingSession.name: getCategoryFilter
PresetBrowsingSession.documentation: Returns the category filter as shown in the category column of the browser. Returns the requested category filter object. Since API version 1

PresetBrowsingSession.name: getFileTypeFilter
PresetBrowsingSession.documentation: Returns the file type filter as shown in the category column of the browser. Returns the requested file type filter object. Since API version 1

PresetBrowsingSession.name: getPresetTypeFilter
PresetBrowsingSession.documentation: Returns the preset type filter as shown in the category column of the browser. Returns the requested preset type filter object. Since API version 1

OscAddressSpace.name: registerDefaultMethod
OscAddressSpace.documentation: This method will be called if no registered OscMethod could handle incoming OscPacket .

OscAddressSpace.signature: void registerMethod ( String address , String typeTagPattern , String desc , OscMethodCallback callback )
OscAddressSpace.documentation: Low level way to register an Osc Method. Parameters address The address to register the method at typeTagPattern The globing pattern used to match the type tag. Pass "*" to match anything. desc The method description. callback The OSC Method call handler.

OscAddressSpace.name: registerObjectMethods
OscAddressSpace.signature: void registerObjectMethods ( final String addressPrefix , Object object ) throws OscInvalidArgumentTypeException
OscAddressSpace.documentation: Register all the methods annotated with } from object. Also if a method is annotated with OscNode}, this method will be called and the returned object's method will be registered.

OscAddressSpace.name: setName
OscAddressSpace.documentation: This gives a display name for this address space. It is useful if you have multiple address space to identify them when we generate the documentation.

OscAddressSpace.name: setShouldLogMessages
OscAddressSpace.documentation: Should the address spaces log the messages it dispatches? Default is false.

OscConnection.name: endBundle
OscConnection.documentation: Finishes the previous bundle, and if it was not inside an other bundle, it will send the message directly.

OscConnection.name: sendMessage
OscConnection.signature: void sendMessage ( String address , Object ... args ) throws IOException, OscInvalidArgumentTypeException
OscConnection.documentation: Supported object types: Integer for int32 Long for int64 Float for float Double for double null for nil Boolean for true and false String for string byte[] for blob

CursorRemoteControlsPage.name: createPresetPage
CursorRemoteControlsPage.documentation: Creates a new preset page. Since API version 16

CursorRemoteControlsPage.name: pageCount

CursorRemoteControlsPage.name: pageNames

CursorRemoteControlsPage.name: selectPreviousPage

CursorRemoteControlsPage.documentation: Selects the previous page that matches the given expression. Parameters expression An expression that can match a page based on how it has been tagged. PinnableCursor.name: isPinned
PinnableCursor.documentation: Determines if this cursor is currently pinned or not. If the cursor is pinned then it won't follow the selection the user makes in the application. Since API version 2

StepDataChangedCallback.name: stepStateChanged
StepDataChangedCallback.signature: void stepStateChanged ( int x , int y , int state )
StepDataChangedCallback.documentation: A callback function that receives three parameters: 1. the x (step) coordinate within the note grid (integer), 2. the y (key) coordinate within the note grid (integer), and 3. an integer value that indicates if the step is empty ( 0 ) or if a note continues playing ( 1 ) or starts playing ( 2 ).

PopupBrowser.name: canAudition

PopupBrowser.name: cancel

PopupBrowser.name: categoryColumn

AsyncTransferCompledCallback.documentation: Called upon completion of an asynchronous read.

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: hardwareButton
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: An optional button that can be associated with this control when this control can also act as a button (e.g by pressing down on it).

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: hasTargetValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: Value that indicates if this hardware control has a target value that it changes or not.

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: isUpdatingTargetValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: Can be called from the targetValue() changed callback to check if this control is responsible for changing the target value or not.

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: modulatedTargetDisplayedValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: Value that represents a formatted text representation of the target's modulated value whenever the value changes. Since API version 11

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: modulatedTargetValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: The value of the target that this hardware control has been bound to (0..1). Since API version 11

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: setHardwareButton
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: Sets an optional button that can be associated with this control when this control can also act as a button (e.g by pressing down on it).

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: targetDisplayedValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: Value that represents a formatted text representation of the target value whenever the value changes. Since API version 11

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: targetName
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: The name of the target that this hardware control has been bound to. Since API version 11

ContinuousHardwareControl.name: targetValue
ContinuousHardwareControl.documentation: The value of the target that this hardware control has been bound to (0..1).

ColorValue.name: green

ColorValue.name: red
ColorValue.documentation: Gets the red component of the current value. Since API version 2

TextExtents.name: getAdvanceX
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the distance to advance in the X direction after drawing these glyphs.

TextExtents.name: getAdvanceY
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the distance to advance in the Y direction after drawing these glyphs. Will typically be zero except for vertical text layout as found in East-Asian languages.

TextExtents.name: getBearingX
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the horizontal distance from the origin to the leftmost part of the glyphs as drawn. Positive if the glyphs lie entirely to the right of the origin.

TextExtents.name: getBearingY
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the vertical distance from the origin to the topmost part of the glyphs as drawn. Positive only if the glyphs lie completely below the origin; will usually be negative.

TextExtents.name: getHeight
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the height of the glyphs as drawn.

TextExtents.name: getWidth
TextExtents.documentation: Returns the width of the glyphs as drawn.

HardwareButton.name: pressedAction
HardwareButton.documentation: Action that happens when the user presses the button.

HardwareButton.name: releasedAction
HardwareButton.documentation: Action that happens when the user releases the button.

HardwareButton.name: setAftertouchControl
HardwareButton.documentation: Sets the optional control that represents the aftertouch value for this button.

HardwareButton.name: setRoundedCornerRadius
HardwareButton.documentation: An indication of how rounded the corners of this button should be.

Bank.name: cursorIndex
Bank.documentation: An integer value that defines the location of the cursor that this bank is following. If there is no cursor or the cursor is not within the bank then the value is -1. Since API version 2

Bank.name: getCapacityOfBank
Bank.documentation: The maximum number of items in the bank which is defined when the bank is initially created. Since API version 7

Bank.name: getItemAt
Bank.documentation: Gets the item in the bank at the supplied index. The index must be >= 0 and < getSizeOfBank() . Since API version 2

Bank.name: getSizeOfBank
Bank.documentation: The fixed size of this bank. This will be initially equal to the capacity of the Bank . Since API version 2

Bank.name: itemCount
Bank.documentation: Value that reports the underlying total item count (not the number of items available in the bank window). Since API version 2

Bank.name: scrollPageBackwards
Bank.documentation: Scrolls backwards by one page. Since API version 2 Implements Scrollable .

Bank.name: scrollPageForwards
Bank.documentation: Scrolls forwards by one page. Since API version 2 Implements Scrollable .

Bank.name: setSizeOfBank
Bank.documentation: Sets the size of this bank Parameters size number of items in the bank that has to be greater than 0 and less or equal to the capacity of the bank. Since API version 7

Bank.name: setSkipDisabledItems
Bank.documentation: Disabled items will not be accessible via the bank if set to true. Since API version 11

ControllerExtensionDefinition.name: getHardwareModel

ControllerExtensionDefinition.name: getHardwareVendor

HardwareAction.name: setShouldFireEvenWhenUsedAsNoteInput

However, occasionally it is useful for a note event to be played as both note input and also trigger some action. For example, a drum pad may play a note but in a special mode on the controller it should also select the pad somehow. In this case it would be both note input and the action that fires to select the pad. Since API version 11

MidiIn.documentation: Creates a note input that appears in the track input choosers in Bitwig Studio. This method must be called within the init() function of the script. The messages matching the given mask parameter will be fed directly to the application, and are not processed by the script. Parameters name the name of the note input as it appears in the track input choosers in Bitwig Studio masks a filter string formatted as hexadecimal value with ? as wildcard. For example 80???? would match note-off on channel 1 (0). When this parameter is {@null}, a standard filter will be used to forward note-related messages on channel 1 (0). If multiple note input match the same MIDI event then they'll all receive the MIDI event, and if one of them does not consume events then the events wont' be consumed. Returns the object representing the requested note input Since API version 1

Value.name: markInterested
Value.documentation: Marks this value as being of interest to the driver. This can only be called once during the driver's init method. A value that is of interest to the driver can be obtained using the value's get method. If a value has not been marked as interested then an error will be reported if the driver attempts to get the current value. IndexedColorValueChangedCallback.signature: void valueChanged ( int index , float red , float green , float blue )

OscModule.name: connectToUdpServer
OscModule.signature: OscConnection connectToUdpServer ( String host , int port , OscAddressSpace addressSpace )
OscModule.documentation: Tries to connect to an OscServer . Parameters addressSpace can be null Returns a new OscConnection Since API version 5

OscModule.name: createAddressSpace
OscModule.documentation: Creates a new OscAddressSpace . In short the OscAddressSpace dispatches the incoming messages to services. An OscAddressSpace is an OscService. Since API version 5

OscModule.name: createUdpServer
OscModule.signature: void createUdpServer ( int port , OscAddressSpace addressSpace )
OscModule.documentation: Creates a new OSC Server. Parameters addressSpace Use createAddressSpace() Since API version 5

OscModule.documentation: Creates a new OSC Server. This server is not started yet, you'll have to start it by calling server.start(port); Use this method if the port is not known during the initialization (coming from a setting) or if the port number can change at runtime. Parameters addressSpace Use createAddressSpace() Returns a new OscServer Since API version 10

SampleBrowsingSession.name: getFileTypeFilter
SampleBrowsingSession.documentation: Returns the file type filter as shown in the category column of the browser. Returns the requested file type filter object. Since API version 1

RelativeHardwarControlBindable.name: addBinding
RelativeHardwarControlBindable.documentation: Binds this target to the supplied hardware control so that when the user moves the hardware control this target will respond in a meaningful way. When the binding is no longer needed the HardwareBinding#removeBinding() method can be called on it. Implemented in SettableRangedValue .

RelativeHardwarControlBindable.name: addBindingWithSensitivity
RelativeHardwarControlBindable.signature: RelativeHardwareControlBinding addBindingWithSensitivity ( RelativeHardwareControl hardwareControl , double sensitivity )
RelativeHardwarControlBindable.documentation: Binds this target to the supplied hardware control so that when the user moves the hardware control this target will respond in a meaningful way. When the binding is no longer needed the HardwareBinding#removeBinding() method can be called on it. Implemented in SettableRangedValue .

Device.name: addActiveModulationSourceObserver
Device.signature: void addActiveModulationSourceObserver ( int len , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the name of the active modulation source. Parameters len the maximum length of the name. Longer names will get truncated. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single name parameter (string) Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use createCursorRemoteControlsPage(int) instead.

Device.name: addDirectParameterIdObserver
Device.documentation: Adds an observer on a list of all parameters for the device. The callback always updates with an array containing all the IDs for the device. Parameters callback function with the signature (String[]) Since API version 1

Device.name: addDirectParameterNameObserver
Device.signature: void addDirectParameterNameObserver ( int maxChars , DirectParameterNameChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Adds an observer for the parameter names (initial and changes) of all parameters for the device. Parameters maxChars maximum length of the string sent to the observer. callback function with the signature (String ID, String name) Since API version 1

Device.name: addDirectParameterNormalizedValueObserver
Device.documentation: Adds an observer for the parameter display value (initial and changes) of all parameters for the device. Parameters callback a callback function with the signature (String ID, float normalizedValue). If the value is not accessible 'Number.NaN' (not-a-number) is reported, can be checked with 'isNaN(value)'. Since API version 1

Device.name: addDirectParameterValueDisplayObserver
Device.documentation: Returns an observer that reports changes of parameter display values, i.e. parameter values formatted as a string to be read by the user, for example "-6.02 dB". The returned observer object can be used to configure which parameters should be observed. By default no parameters are observed. It should be avoided to observe all parameters at the same time for performance reasons. Returns an observer object that can be used to enable or disable actual observing for certain parameters. Parameters maxChars maximum length of the string sent to the observer. callback function with the signature (String ID, String valueDisplay) Since API version 1

Device.name: addHasSelectedDeviceObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the device is selected. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use exists() instead.

Device.name: addIsEnabledObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the device is enabled. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use isEnabled() instead.

Device.name: addIsPluginObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the device is a plugin. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use isPlugin() instead

Device.name: addNameObserver
Device.signature: void addNameObserver ( int len , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the name of the device. Parameters len the maximum length of the name. Longer names will get truncated. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single name (string) parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use name() instead

Device.name: addNextParameterPageEnabledObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if there is a next parameter page. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter Since API version 1

Device.name: addPageNamesObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the names of the devices parameter pages. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single string array parameter containing the names of the parameter pages Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use createCursorRemoteControlsPage(int) instead.

Device.name: addPositionObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the position of the device within the parent device chain. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single integer parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use position() instead.

Device.name: addPresetCategoriesObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the names of the available preset categories for the device. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single string array parameter containing the names of the preset categories Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use the new browser API instead.

Device.name: addPresetCategoryObserver
Device.signature: void addPresetCategoryObserver ( int len , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the current preset category name. Parameters len the maximum length of the name. Longer names will get truncated. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single name (string) parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: use presetCategory() instead.

Device.name: addPresetCreatorObserver
Device.signature: void addPresetCreatorObserver ( int len , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the current preset creator name. Parameters len the maximum length of the name. Longer names will get truncated. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single name (string) parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use presetCreator() instead.

Device.name: addPresetCreatorsObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the names of the available preset creators for the device. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single string array parameter containing the names of the preset creators Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use the new browser API instead.

Device.name: addPresetNameObserver
Device.signature: void addPresetNameObserver ( int len , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the last loaded preset name. Parameters len the maximum length of the name. Longer names will get truncated. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single name (string) parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use presetName() .addValueObserver(callback) instead.

Device.name: addPresetNamesObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the names of the available presets for the device according to the current configuration of preset category and creator filtering. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single string array parameter containing the names of the presets for the current category and creator filter. See also addPresetCategoryObserver addPresetCreatorObserver setPresetCategory setPresetCreator Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use the new browser API instead.

Device.name: addPreviousParameterPageEnabledObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if there is a previous parameter page. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter Since API version 1

Device.name: addSampleNameObserver
Device.signature: void addSampleNameObserver ( int maxChars , String textWhenUnassigned , StringValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the file name of the currently loaded sample, in case the device is a sample container device. Parameters maxChars maximum length of the string sent to the observer. textWhenUnassigned the default name that gets reported when the device is not associated with a Bitwig Studio device yet. callback a callback function that receives a single string parameter. Deprecated: Use sampleName() instead.

Device.name: addSelectedPageObserver
Device.signature: void addSelectedPageObserver ( int valueWhenUnassigned , IntegerValueChangedCallback callback )
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the currently selected parameter page. Parameters valueWhenUnassigned the default page index that gets reported when the device is not associated with a device instance in Bitwig Studio yet. callback a callback function that receives a single page index parameter (integer) Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use createCursorRemoteControlsPage(int) instead.

Device.name: addSlotsObserver
Device.documentation: Registers an observer that gets notified when the list of available FX slots changes. Parameters callback a callback function which takes a single string array argument that contains the names of the slots. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use slotNames() instead.

Device.name: afterDeviceInsertionPoint
Device.documentation: InsertionPoint that can be used for inserting after this device. Since API version 7

Device.name: beforeDeviceInsertionPoint

Device.documentation: Starts browsing for content that can be inserted before this device in Bitwig Studio's popup browser. Since API version 2 Deprecated: Use afterDeviceInsertionPoint() instead.

Device.name: createChainSelector
Device.documentation: Creates a ChainSelector object which will give you control over the current device if it is an Instrument Selector or an Effect Selector. To check if the device is currently a ChainSelector , use ChainSelector.exists() . If you want to have access to all the chains, use createLayerBank(int) . Returns a chain selector instance Since API version 6

Device.name: createCursorLayer
Device.documentation: Returns a device layer instance that can be used to navigate the layers or drum pads of the device, in case it has any This is the selected layer from the user interface. Returns a cursor device layer instance Since API version 1

Device.name: createCursorRemoteControlsPage
Device.documentation: Creates a cursor for the selected remote controls page in the device with the supplied number of parameters. This section will follow the current page selection made by the user in the application. Parameters parameterCount The number of parameters the remote controls should contain Since API version 2

Device.name: createCursorRemoteControlsPage
Device.signature: CursorRemoteControlsPage createCursorRemoteControlsPage ( String name , int parameterCount , String filterExpression )
Device.documentation: Creates a cursor for a remote controls page in the device with the supplied number of parameters. This section will be independent from the current page selected by the user in Bitwig Studio's user interface. The supplied filter is an expression that can be used to match pages this section is interested in. The expression is matched by looking at the tags added to the pages. If the expression is empty then no filtering will occur. Parameters name A name to associate with this section. This will be used to remember manual mappings made by the user within this section. parameterCount The number of parameters the remote controls should contain filterExpression An expression used to match pages that the user can navigate through. For now this can only be the name of a single tag the pages should contain (e.g "drawbars", "dyn", "env", "eq", "filter", "fx", "lfo", "mixer", "osc", "overview", "perf"). Since API version 2

Device.name: createDeviceBrowser
Device.signature: Browser createDeviceBrowser ( final int numFilterColumnEntries , final int numResultsColumnEntries )
Device.documentation: Returns an object used for browsing devices, presets and other content. Committing the browsing session will load or create a device from the selected resource and replace the current device. Parameters numFilterColumnEntries the size of the window used to navigate the filter column entries. numResultsColumnEntries the size of the window used to navigate the results column entries. Returns the requested device browser object. Since API version 1

Device.name: createDrumPadBank

Device.name: createLayerBank
Device.documentation: Create a bank for navigating the nested layers of the device using a fixed-size window. This bank will work over the following devices: Instrument Layer Effect Layer Instrument Selector Effect Selector Parameters numChannels the number of channels that the device layer bank should be configured with Returns a device layer bank object configured with the desired number of channels Since API version 1

Device.name: createSiblingsDeviceBank
Device.documentation: Returns an object that provides bank-wise navigation of sibling devices of the same device chain (including the device instance used to create the siblings bank). Parameters numDevices the number of devices that are simultaneously accessible Returns the requested device bank object @ Since API version 1

Device.documentation: Returns a representation of the device chain that contains this device. Possible device chain instances are tracks, device layers, drums pads, or FX slots. Returns the requested device chain object Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use deviceChain() instead.

Device.name: getEnvelopeParameter
Device.documentation: Returns the parameter with the given index in the envelope parameter page. Parameters index the index of the parameter within the envelope parameter page. Returns an object that provides access to the requested parameter @ Since API version 1 Deprecated: The remote controls deprecate this feature. Instead create remote controls with createIndependentRemoteControls(String, int, String) .

Instead the user can define pages of mappings and these should be used instead.

Device.name: hasDrumPads
Device.documentation: Indicates if the device has individual device chains for each note value. Returns a value object that indicates if the device has individual device chains for each note value. Since API version 1

Device.name: hasLayers
Device.documentation: Indicates if the device supports nested layers. Returns a value object that indicates if the device supports nested layers. Since API version 1

Returns a value object that indicates if the device has nested device chains in FX slots. Since API version 1

Device.name: incDirectParameterValueNormalized

FontExtents.name: getAscent
FontExtents.documentation: Returns the distance that the font extends above the baseline. Note that this is not always exactly equal to the maximum of the extents of all the glyphs in the font, but rather is picked to express the font designer's intent as to how the font should align with elements above it.

FontExtents.name: getDescent
FontExtents.documentation: Returns the distance that the font extends below the baseline. This value is positive for typical fonts that include portions below the baseline. Note that this is not always exactly equal to the maximum of the extents of all the glyphs in the font, but rather is picked to express the font designer's intent as to how the the font should align with elements below it.

FontExtents.name: getHeight
FontExtents.documentation: Returns the recommended vertical distance between baselines when setting consecutive lines of text with the font. This is greater than ascent+descent by a quantity known as the line spacing or external leading. When space is at a premium, most fonts can be set with only a distance of ascent+descent between lines.

FontExtents.name: getMaxAdvanceX
FontExtents.documentation: the maximum distance in the X direction that the the origin is advanced for any glyph in the font.

FontExtents.name: getMaxAdvanceY
FontExtents.documentation: Returns the maximum distance in the Y direction that the the origin is advanced for any glyph in the font. this will be zero for normal fonts used for horizontal writing. (The scripts of East Asia are sometimes written vertically.)

SettableIntegerValue.name: inc
SettableIntegerValue.documentation: Increases/decrease the internal value by the given amount. Parameters amount the integer amount to increase Since API version 1

SettableIntegerValue.name: set
SettableIntegerValue.documentation: Sets the internal value. Parameters value the new integer value. Since API version 1

SettableEnumValue.name: set
SettableEnumValue.documentation: Sets the value to the enumeration item with the given name. Parameters name the name of the new enum item Since API version 1

Browser.name: activateSession
Browser.documentation: Activates the given search session. Please note that only one search session can be active at a time. Parameters session the session that should be activated. Since API version 1

Browser.name: addIsBrowsingObserver
Browser.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if a browsing session was started. Parameters callback a callback function that receivers a single boolean parameter. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use exists() instead.

Browser.name: cancelBrowsing
Browser.documentation: Cancels the current browser session. Since API version 1

Browser.name: commitSelectedResult
Browser.documentation: Finished the browser session by loading the selected item. Since API version 1

Browser.name: createCursorSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that represents the selected tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested browsing session cursor Since API version 1

Browser.name: createSessionBank
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provided bank-wise navigation of the available search sessions. Each search session is dedicated to a certain material type, as shown in the tabs of Bitwig Studio's contextual browser. Parameters size the size of the windows used to navigate the available browsing sessions. Returns the requested file column bank object Since API version 1

Browser.name: getClipSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the clips tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested clip browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: getDeviceSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the device tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested device browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: getMultiSampleSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the multi-samples tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested multi-sample browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: getMusicSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the music tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested music browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: getPresetSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the preset tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested preset browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: getSampleSession
Browser.documentation: Returns an object that provides access to the contents of the samples tab as shown in Bitwig Studio's contextual browser window. Returns the requested sample browsing session instance Since API version 1

Browser.name: isWindowMinimized
Browser.documentation: Return an object allows to observe and control if the browser window should be small or full-sized. Returns a boolean value object Since API version 1

Browser.name: shouldAudition
Browser.documentation: Return an object allows to observe and control if the selected result should be auditioned. Returns a boolean value object Since API version 1

Browser.name: startBrowsing
Browser.documentation: Starts a new browser session. Since API version 1

Image.name: getHeight
Image.documentation: Returns the height Implemented in Bitmap .

Image.name: getWidth
Image.documentation: Returns the width Implemented in Bitmap .

HardwareDeviceMatcherList.name: add
HardwareDeviceMatcherList.documentation: Adds information about a hardware device that is needed and how it can be matched. The hardware device will need to match at least one of the supplied matchers. For each entry added to this list the user will see a device chooser that lets them select an appropriate device. The information added here is also used for auto detection purposes.

HardwareDeviceMatcherList.name: getCount
HardwareDeviceMatcherList.documentation: The number of hardware devices in the list.

ChannelBank.name: addCanScrollChannelsDownObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the channel bank can be scrolled further down. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use canScrollChannelsDown() .addValueObserver(callback)

ChannelBank.name: addCanScrollChannelsUpObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the channel bank can be scrolled further up. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single boolean parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use canScrollChannelsUp() .addValueObserver(callback)

ChannelBank.name: addCanScrollSendsDownObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the sends window can be scrolled further down. Parameters callback a callback function that takes a single boolean parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: addCanScrollSendsUpObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports if the sends window can be scrolled further up. Parameters callback a callback function that takes a single boolean parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: addChannelCountObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the underlying total channel count (not the number of channels available in the bank window). Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single integer parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use channelCount() .addValueObserver(callback)

ChannelBank.name: addChannelScrollPositionObserver
ChannelBank.signature: void addChannelScrollPositionObserver ( IntegerValueChangedCallback callback , int valueWhenUnassigned )
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the current scroll position, more specifically the position of the first channel within the underlying list of channels, that is shown as channel zero within the bank. Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single integer number parameter valueWhenUnassigned a default value for the channel position that gets reported in case the channel bank is not connected to a list of channels in Bitwig Studio. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use channelScrollPosition() instead

ChannelBank.name: addSendCountObserver
ChannelBank.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the underlying total send count (not the number of sends available in the bank window). Parameters callback a callback function that receives a single integer parameter Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: canScrollChannelsDown
ChannelBank.documentation: Value that reports if the channel bank can be scrolled further down. Since API version 2

ChannelBank.name: canScrollChannelsUp
ChannelBank.documentation: Value that reports if the channel bank can be scrolled further down. Since API version 2

ChannelBank.name: channelCount
ChannelBank.documentation: Value that reports the underlying total channel count (not the number of channels available in the bank window). Since API version 2

ChannelBank.name: channelScrollPosition
ChannelBank.documentation: Value that reports the current scroll position, more specifically the position of the first channel within the underlying list of channels, that is shown as channel zero within the bank. Since API version 2 Deprecated: scrollPosition()

ChannelBank.name: getChannel
ChannelBank.documentation: Returns the channel for the given index. Parameters indexInBank the channel index within this bank, not the index within the list of all Bitwig Studio channels. Must be in the range [0..sizeOfBank-1]. Returns the channel object Since API version 1 Deprecated: Use getItemAt(int) instead.

ChannelBank.name: scrollChannelsDown
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the channel window down by the amount specified via setChannelScrollStepSize(int) (by default one channel). Since API version 1 Deprecated: scrollForwards()

ChannelBank.name: scrollChannelsPageDown
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the channels one page up. For example if the channel bank is configured with a window size of 8 channels and is currently showing channel [9..16], calling this method would scroll the channel bank to show channel [1..8]. Since API version 1 Deprecated: scrollPageForwards()

ChannelBank.name: scrollChannelsPageUp
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the channels one page up. For example if the channel bank is configured with a window size of 8 channels and is currently showing channel [1..8], calling this method would scroll the channel bank to show channel [9..16]. Since API version 1 Deprecated: scrollPageBackwards()

ChannelBank.name: scrollChannelsUp
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the channel window up by the amount specified via setChannelScrollStepSize(int) (by default one channel). Since API version 1 Deprecated: scrollBackwards()

ChannelBank.name: scrollSendsDown
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the sends one step down. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: scrollSendsPageDown
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the sends one page down. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: scrollSendsPageUp
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the sends one page up. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: scrollSendsUp
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the sends one step up. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: scrollToChannel
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls the channel bank window so that the channel at the given position becomes visible. Parameters position the index of the channel within the underlying full list of channels (not the index within the bank). The position is typically directly related to the layout of the channel list in Bitwig Studio, starting with zero in case of the first channel. Since API version 1 Deprecated: scrollPosition()

ChannelBank.name: scrollToSend
ChannelBank.documentation: Scrolls to the send. Parameters position the index of the send. Since API version 1 Deprecated: Does nothing.

ChannelBank.name: setChannelScrollStepSize
ChannelBank.documentation: Sets the step size used for scrolling the channel bank. Parameters stepSize the step size used for scrolling. Default is 1 . Since API version 1

IndexedStringValueChangedCallback.name: valueChanged
IndexedStringValueChangedCallback.signature: void valueChanged ( int index , String newValue )
IndexedStringValueChangedCallback.documentation: Registers an observer that reports the names of the scenes and slots. The slot names reflect the names of containing clips. Parameters callback a callback function receiving two parameters: 1. the slot index (integer) within the configured window, and 2. the name of the scene/slot (string) Since API version 1
